name: The drainage chart for the Canal Pump and Works
subject: projects
brief: Four of you are preparing a geography-and-civics display chart on the Canal Pump and Works: tracing the ward contour map, tabulating the pump-house log, and mounting the photograph strip. You are in the chair, and every flat table in the geography room is crowded with other groups' drawing boards.

tasks.name: Ink the ward contour and sluice map on tracing cloth
Tabulate the monsoon pump-house discharge figures
Mount and caption the four sluice photographs

facts.text: The project allowance holds 120 rupees, and linen tracing cloth plus darkroom prints would cost 165 rupees
The stationer can substitute heavy butter-paper for 40 rupees if ordered before noon
Arup has a 0.4-millimetre mapping nib in his geometry tin

note: Uses the Canal Pump and Works (loc_canal_works), Ishan Sheikh (npc_ishan_sheikh), and Mira Sen (npc_mira_sen) from INDIA_WORLD_BIBLE.md. Exercises 2 critical-fact holders (Mira and Ishan) while Arup holds only a non-critical fact.
